horoscopes.title: Aries Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: Martian transit is on through the fourth house, so the home and family will be important. You will see some work happening around the house, mainly repairs, rearrangements, maintenance, real estate deals or something that has been waiting for attention. You will face a few tense moments with family members, especially when everyone wants things done differently. A vehicle will also demand attention, and some money will go towards repair, servicing, or another practical expense. You will experience more involvement in a parent's affairs, and one situation there will need your time. Work matters will follow you home on certain days.

The new moon will rise in the earth sign of Virgo, and it will bring new events at work. You will face unfinished tasks that will suddenly need to be cleared within a short time. There are chances for some arguments with your colleagues, so make sure you avoid unhealthy talks at work. You will experience changes in your daily schedule, including busier mornings and longer working hours. An expense connected with health, medicines, or regular necessities will also arise. You will see an old problem finally reaching a turning point. Competition will increase, but you will successfully handle an opponent or difficult situation.

Venus will enter Scorpio, so your financial matters will be triggered positively. You will receive news about a loan, insurance, tax, inheritance, settlement, or money shared with a partner. An old financial matter will return and will finally move towards a conclusion. You will experience a noticeable change in intimacy, and a private relationship will become much deeper than before. Something kept hidden in a relationship will come into the open and will lead to an important conversation. You will see unexpected expenses appearing alongside some financial support from another source. Family finances will also need discussion.

horoscopes.title: Taurus Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: For the last few weeks, your third house is active with transit Mars in Cancer. There will be a lot of online and offline conversations, but there will be more arguments too. You will take up a new task that will require courage and continuous effort from your side. Some disagreements with siblings or close relatives will happen, mainly over decisions or responsibilities. Your work will involve more writing, communication, documentation, or coordination. You will also make several short trips connected with work or personal matters. Transfers, short trips will be coming up, and due to these, so physical issues can also come up.

The new moon of September will rise in Virgo, which will bring a lot of creative projects and youngsters around you. You will see a new development in the life of a child or younger family member. Those who are studying will receive a new project, course, examination schedule, or important academic responsibility. Your romantic life will also become active, and a new conversation or meeting will change the direction of a relationship. Some of you will restart a creative project that was left unfinished earlier. You will also spend money on children, entertainment, hobbies, or social activities. A new personal interest will begin and will take up more of your time.

Venus, the planet of love will enter the water sign of Scorpio, so the seventh house will be active for the next twenty plus days. Virgo Sun, Moon and rising will focus on improving their love life. There will be frequent social gatherings and business meets, so the chances to meet new people will increase. Singles among you will find someone special but please don’t keep any high expectations from anyone. You will receive support from another person in an important matter. Business owners will see new clients, agreements, or partnership discussions coming in. An existing relationship will become closer, while an unsettled relationship will finally move towards a clear decision.

horoscopes.title: Gemini Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: For the last few weeks, your second house is active with transit Mars in Cancer. Money, family matters, savings, and financial responsibilities will demand more attention. There will be unexpected expenses, and you will have to make some quick financial decisions. Arguments can come up within the family, especially because of money, property, or responsibilities. You will become more direct in your speech, and sometimes your words can create unnecessary problems. The second house indicates career, so there will be opportunities for new fulltime or freelance jobs.. There will also be discussions about salary, income, investments, or a new source of earnings. You have to take care of your food habits and the health of facial organs too.

The New Moon of September will rise in Virgo, so your fourth house will become active, bringing new developments connected with home, family, property, vehicles, and your living environment. Property-related discussions and paperwork will also come up. You will spend money on furniture, household appliances, vehicles, or other domestic requirements. A new development will happen in the life of your mother or another important family member. Those living away from their hometown will make plans to visit home. Some of you will also see changes connected with your workplace, office location, work-from-home arrangements, or seating arrangements.

Venus, the planet of love, will enter the water sign of Scorpio, so the sixth house will be active for the next twenty-plus days. Gemini Sun, Moon, and rising will have a busy phase at work, and there will be more interaction with colleagues, clients, and team members. A new project, responsibility, or work opportunity will come up. You can also expect some competitive events too. There can be some competition and jealousy at the workplace, so office relationships will become complicated for some of you. There will be some expenses for health, pets and you will also think about repayment.

horoscopes.title: Cancer Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: For Cancer Sun, Moon and rising, the personal life will be very important as Mars will be moving through your sign. Arguments can come up because you will become more direct and less willing to compromise. There will also be changes in your appearance, daily routine, or personal plans. Some of you will start a new project or take an important decision regarding your future. Physical activity and travelling will increase, but tiredness, headaches, minor injuries, inflammation, or body pain can also come up, so your health will need more attention. Mars is the planet for arguments, so there will be arguments with people around you.

The New Moon of September will rise in Virgo, so your third house will become active, bringing new developments connected with communication, siblings, travel, paperwork, and new projects. There will be a lot of conversations from personal and professional life. Some of you will start a course, a project connected to writing, training program, or skill-development activity. There will be more interaction with siblings, neighbours, and close relatives, and an important development will happen in their lives too. Short trips will increase, and some of these journeys will be connected with work. Short travels, plenty of social media and activity and minor physical issues also can come up.

The love life and creative abilities will be important as Venus is moving through the fifth house. Cancer Sun, Moon, and rising will focus more on romance, children, creativity, entertainment, and personal happiness. Singles will find someone special and there will be more outings, dates, celebrations, parties, and social gatherings. Some of you will restart a creative project or receive appreciation for your talents. Matters connected with children will bring important developments, and you will spend more time and money on their education, activities, or other needs.

horoscopes.title: Leo Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: Mars is moving through the twelfth house of isolation and detachment so you will like to be alone. Foreign collaborations, and traveling will be normal during this transit. This is the time to journal, and make long term planning too. Sleep can become disturbed because of work pressure, travelling, or overthinking. Some disagreements can happen with people who work against you secretly. Those working with foreign companies or clients will have more responsibilities. Hospital visits or medical expenses can also come up for you or someone in the family. You will also feel the need to stay away from certain people and situations for some time.

The new moon will rise in the second house, so for the next six months, financial matters, family matters and finances will be important. Some of you will receive a new source of income or start planning an additional income-generating activity. A new purchase will also come up, and money will be spent on household requirements, food, jewellery, or valuable items. There will be some changes within the family, and an important event connected with a family member will demand your attention. Those waiting for a salary revision, payment, or financial settlement will receive new information. There are chances or new full time to part time job as well.

For Leo natives the family matters will be highly active for the next three weeks as Venus will enter Scorpio this week. There will be some real estate deals like renovation, relocation or some family meetings. This Venus will cool down the tensed situations at home, so you will be having better time at home. The chances to get better real estate deals will come up. Venus will aspect the tenth house, and that will bring some creative projects too.

horoscopes.title: Virgo Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: For the last few weeks, your eleventh house is active with transit Mars in Cancer, so there will be a lot of activity within your friendships, professional networks, and team settings. You will meet more people through work and social gatherings, but there will be some arguments within groups too. An old friend or former colleague will contact you, and there will be discussions about a new plan or project. Your income will also become an important subject, and you will look for additional sources of earnings. However, there will be some arguments within the team as well.

The new moon of September will rise in your own sign Virgo, so this will bring a fresh phase into your personal life. There will be changes in your appearance, daily routine, personal plans, and the way you deal with others. You will start something new that will remain important for the coming months. Virgo Sun, Moon and rising natives will be opening a new chapter, which will take the next six months to complete. You will become busier with meetings, appointments, paperwork, and discussions connected with your future. A new responsibility will come directly to you, and others will expect you to take the lead. There will also be changes in your physical routine, and you will become more focused on your health, food, appearance, and personal needs.

This is a crucial week for Venus as it will change sign, and enter Scorpio. This will trigger the third house of multitasking, so you will have a lot of work from communication based domain. This is the time to reconnect with siblings, neighbours or your network circles. Some of you will travel for a family function, social gathering, work meeting, or personal event. A new course, training program, writing project, or online activity will also begin. Those working in media, teaching, sales, marketing, content, or communication-related fields will receive new assignments.

horoscopes.title: Libra Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: Your professional matters are highlighted for the last few days as Mars is in Cancer. You will have more meetings with managers, clients, or senior people, and some conversations can turn into arguments. Those looking for a job will see interviews and new openings coming up. A change in role, team, reporting manager, or location will also come up for some of you. Business owners will become more aggressive about expanding their work. Mars is debilitated in Cancer, so there are chances of arguments at work.

There will be more expenses for the next six months as the new moon will rise in Virgo, especially for travel, health, family needs, or things that cannot be postponed. Some of you will make plans for a foreign journey, relocation, or work connected with another country. There will be more private meetings and confidential discussions at work too. You will spend some time away from your usual surroundings, and an unexpected journey can also come up. Sleep can get disturbed due to the busy schedule and other concerns. You will get some updates from the foreign lands; it can be about personal matters as well.

Venus, your ruling planet, will enter the water sign of Scorpio, so your second house will be active for the next twenty plus days. Money, family matters, savings, and possessions will become important. You will receive money, a pending payment, incentive, or another financial benefit, and some of you will start looking at a new source of income. At the same time, you will spend on clothes, jewellery, beauty products, food, family functions, or household requirements. There will be family gatherings and discussions about money, property, or future expenses. You will also buy something valuable for yourself or the family. Those working in business will see better financial transactions, while salary-related discussions or negotiations will come up for others.

horoscopes.title: Scorpio Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: There are significant events happening connected to your foreign collaborations, higher studies, and spirituality as Mars is in Cancer. Long distance travel for personal and professional reasons can come up, but there are chances for blocks too. You will have more interaction with people from different places and backgrounds. Students will become busy with admissions, examinations, applications, or higher education plans. There will be some disagreements with your father, teachers, mentors, or senior people. Legal or documentation matters will also demand attention. Those working with foreign companies will get new responsibilities, and discussions regarding overseas opportunities will move forward.

For the next six months your team work and friendships will be active as the new moon will rise in the eleventh house. You will meet new people, and some of these connections will become useful for your career. A new team project or group activity will begin. You will receive news regarding income, pending payments, incentives, or additional earnings. Friends will contact you more frequently, and there will be invitations to meetings, functions, and social gatherings. Those looking for a new job will receive information through friends or professional contacts. You will also make new plans regarding your long-term goals, and one important plan will start moving forward.

Venus will enter your own sign Scorpio, so your first house will be active for the next twenty plus days. Your personal life, appearance, relationships, and social activities will get more attention. You will spend money on clothes, beauty treatments, accessories, or other personal requirements. Singles among you will meet someone interesting through work, friends, or social gatherings. Those already in relationships will spend more time with their partner. You will also receive attention from others, and an important relationship discussion will take place. Some of you will buy new accessories to improve the appearance.

horoscopes.title: Sagittarius Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: For the last few weeks, your eighth house is active with transit Mars in Cancer, so finances, loans, taxes, insurance, inheritance, and shared resources will need more attention. There will be unexpected expenses, and some old financial matters will return for settlement. You will have discussions regarding money shared with your spouse or family members. Loans, EMI, tax payments, insurance claims, or other financial commitments will move forward. Some of you will receive money that was delayed earlier. There will also be sudden changes in existing plans, mainly due to financial or family matters. Your health will need attention too, and minor physical issues can come up. Research and confidential work will also increase.

The new moon of September will rise in Virgo, so your tenth house will bring new events in your career. There will be a new project, responsibility, role, or change in your workplace. You will have important discussions with managers and senior people regarding your future at work. Those looking for a job will see interviews and new openings coming up. Some of you will hear about a transfer, promotion, department change, or additional responsibility. Business owners will start new plans and will meet potential clients. Your work will become more visible, and people in authority will closely watch your performance.

Venus will enter the water sign of Scorpio, so your twelfth house will be active for the next twenty plus days. There will be some expenses for personal or professional reasons. Some of you will travel to another state or country, while others will start planning an overseas journey. There will be more communication with people living abroad, and those working with foreign companies will receive new assignments. A private relationship can also become important during this period. You will spend more time away from your regular social circle. Expenses connected with a partner will come up, and an old relationship or someone from the past can return unexpectedly.

horoscopes.title: Capricorn Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: Some significant events are happening in your seventh house of relationships; it may not be very sweet as well. There will be serious discussions with your spouse or partner, and arguments can happen over money, family matters, or responsibilities. Singles among you will meet new people, and one connection will develop quickly. Business partnerships will become active with meetings, negotiations, and new agreements. You will deal with more clients and customers, especially if you are self-employed. An existing partnership will go through an important change. There will be new people but avoid sharing your secrets with them.

You are sincerely planning for some long trips as the ninth house will be active with the new moon for the next six months. Some of you will plan a long journey or receive news regarding an overseas opportunity. Students will become busy with admissions, examinations, research, or higher studies. Applications, visas, certificates, and official documents will move forward. There will be important interactions with teachers, mentors, or people from different backgrounds. Your father will also go through an important development. Work-related travel will come up, and those waiting for legal or official matters to move will see some progress.

Venus will enter the water sign of Scorpio, so your eleventh house will be active for the next twenty plus days. Pleasant social gatherings will surely come up, and you will get new contacts. You will reconnect with old friends and meet new people through work and common connections. Income will improve through salary, business, commissions, incentives, or additional projects. A pending payment will also reach some of you. Friends will support you in an important matter, and one professional contact will bring a useful opportunity. Business owners will find new customers through networking. Singles among you will meet someone through friends or professional circles, and an existing friendship can also develop into something more personal.

horoscopes.title: Aquarius Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: The work and health are very important for the last few days as Mars is in control of these. Arguments with colleagues can happen, especially regarding responsibilities or the way work is being handled. Job seekers will see interviews and new openings coming up. You will also deal with loans, payments, or other financial commitments. Competition will increase, but you will handle your enemies effectively. There will be some competitive events and you will have to prepare for that. Some of you will spend more time with pets.

For the next six months, your financial matters will be a bit sensitive as New moon will kickstart some new liabilities. You will have discussions about loans, taxes, insurance, inheritance, investments, or money shared with your spouse. An old financial matter will return and will need a fresh decision. Some of you will apply for a loan, insurance claim, settlement, or financial assistance. Unexpected expenses will also come up, so money will move in and out quickly. There will be changes in your partner's finances as well. You will also receive some confidential information, and a private family or financial matter will come up for discussion.

Venus will enter the water sign of Scorpio, so your tenth house will be active for the next twenty plus days. Your career will bring some pleasant developments, and your relationship with managers and senior people will improve. You will receive appreciation for your work, and new responsibilities will come your way. Job seekers will see interviews and discussions with potential employers. Those working in creative, media, beauty, fashion, finance, hospitality, or client-related fields will become busier. Business owners will meet new clients and receive useful professional contacts. There will also be office gatherings, meetings, and professional events. Your visibility will also increase.

horoscopes.title: Pisces Weekly Horoscope Starting September 6
content: The fifth house of love, and children will be highly active as Mars is in Cancer. There will be important developments in the life of a child or younger family member, and you will spend more time dealing with their needs. Those in relationships will have some arguments, mainly over expectations and future plans. Singles among you will meet someone, but the connection will move quickly. Students will become busy with examinations, projects, and competitive activities. Creative professionals will take up new assignments.

The seventh house will get impacted with powerful new moon so singles among you will meet new people through work, friends, or social gatherings. Married natives will have some planning for children and their future. Business owners will see new clients, customers, agreements, and partnership proposals. You will attend more meetings and deal with people directly during this period. A new contract or agreement will also come up. Studies will be one of your aims as well.

Venus will enter Scorpio this week, and the ninth house will be active for the next few days. There will be some plans for the long trips, spiritual meetings and some sessions with your mentors. You will be finding someone special during these travels. Students will receive positive developments regarding admissions, courses, examinations, or higher education. Those working with foreign companies will get new assignments and contacts. There will be meetings with teachers, mentors, or people from different backgrounds. Your father will also have a positive development. A relationship with someone from another place or culture can become important, and an overseas opportunity will also move forward.
